item.title: AMD's Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition crams 208MB of cache into a single chip
item.description:
📝 The extra cache does have mild downsides. But the Ryzen 9000 series has steadily eroded the downsides of older Ryzen 5000 and Ryzen 7000 X3D chips. The Ryzen 9950X3D2 Dual Edition will be available starting April 22.
🔗 Read more: https://arstechnica.com/gadgets/2026/03/amds-ryzen-9-9950x3d2-dual-edition-crams-208mb-of-cache-into-a-single-chip/
